content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "This is the real thing underneath it, then. Not just a career pivot, a way of settling something for him.

Ten years of making other people's operations efficient and watching none of that efficiency reach the people actually growing the food. That's a hell of a gap to notice and sit with.

What would it look like for it to matter for people like him? Are you thinking about the farmers directly, or more the system that decides what they get paid?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
